newsitem.title: USA: Sparta Foods Q2 profits as margins climb.
newsitem.headline: Sparta Foods Q2 profits as margins climb.

text.p: Sparta Foods Inc said Wednesday higher gross profit margins and lower expenses helped the company post a profit in the second quarter ended March 31 versus a loss a year ago.

The company posted net income of $70,286, or $0.01 a share, versus a loss of $19,322, or nil, last year. Sales improved to $3.2 million from $3.0 million, primarily because of continued growth in its tortilla business, Sparta said.
Sparta also said it expects to occupy expanded tortilla production facilities by this fall.
Sparta makes and distributes Mexican-style food products to retail grocery chains and to the foodservice industry.
